correctness.rationale: The Gaussian monomial norms are n!, and adding tau|f^(m)(0)|^2 alters only coefficient m, giving deficit q=tau/(1+tau m!). For even m, |e^t-q t^m|>=e^(-|t|)-q|t|^m, attained at t=-r until the unique negative zero enters the disk; thereafter the exact minimum is zero. Strict monotonicity, simple derivative, inverse Lambert W, tau->infinity and Stirling expansion cover all quantified boundaries. verify.py gives supplementary high-precision checks.

The mathematical result is stronger than an isolated zero existence check.
